verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments and billing platform, so automatic tax calculation is a fair axis for it. The evidence covers charges, discounts, interest, fines, split, and automated fiscal invoice (nota fiscal) issuance. None of it documents calculating or collecting sales tax, VAT, or GST on transactions. Invoice automation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically
